content:
The new Apple TV 4K is set to launch in the coming weeks at the iPhone announcement event. Apple code discovered by MacRumors has revealed that a new Siri Remote is on the way.

macOS code references new Apple TV Remote

Apple yesterday rolled out a series of public and beta software updates. Among them, the macOS 26.7 RC update mentions numerous unannounced products.

MacRumors also uncovered a video showing AirPods with a built-in camera in action.

The new Siri Remote for the Apple TV 4K also appears in the list of unreleased products. Juli Clover writes:

Mark Gurman had previously reported that the upcoming hardware refresh would come with an Apple TV Remote that is "likely tweaked."

The discovery of this new-generation Siri Remote in macOS 26.7 suggests that it will indeed arrive this autumn.

There's no word yet on what specific changes the remote will bring. However, a common request has been for an easier way to locate a lost remote. The second-generation ultra-wideband chip found in the AirTag 2 could potentially be integrated into the Siri Remote.

What changes would you like to see in the Siri Remote for the new Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
